title: Citrus County Rabies Alert After Floral City Kitten Tests Positive
headline: 60-Day Rabies Alert Issued for Citrus County After Stray Kitten Tests Positive Near Floral City
key_points: Unvaccinated stray kitten captured near Highway 581 between Inverness and Floral City tested positive for rabies July 18, 2026; Florida Department of Health in Citrus County issued a 60-day alert; residents urged to avoid wild/stray animals, keep pet and livestock vaccinations current, and report bites or scratches to Citrus County Sheriff's Office Animal Control.
angle: Actionable public-safety piece for pet owners and outdoor-active residents in the Floral City/Inverness corridor.
sources: Citrus County Chronicle (chronicleonline.com), Florida Department of Health in Citrus County (citrus.floridahealth.gov), WMNF 88.5 FM

title: 2026 Bay Scallop Season Open in Citrus and Hernando Waters
headline: Scallop Season Is In: What Citrus and Hernando Harvesters Need to Know Before Heading Out
key_points: Recreational bay scallop season runs July 1 - September 24, 2026 in the zone covering Crystal River and Homosassa (south of Alligator Pass daybeacon #4 to the Hernando-Pasco line); daily bag limit 2 gallons whole-in-shell or 1 pint of meat per person, 10 gallons/4 pints per vessel max.
angle: Practical guide for local families and visiting harvesters — dates, limits, and where to launch, timed to peak summer traffic on the Nature Coast.
sources: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission bulletin (via GovDelivery), NatureCoaster.com, VISIT FLORIDA

title: Florida Winter Music Festival Returns to Brooksville
headline: Florida Winter Music Festival Brings Two Days of Live Music to Florida Sand Music Ranch
key_points: Florida Winter Music Festival runs August 8-9, 2026 at Florida Sand Music Ranch in Brooksville.
angle: Weekend-planning piece for Hernando County residents; local venue spotlight.
sources: Eventbrite Hernando County listings, Florida's Adventure Coast events calendar

title: Hernando County Primary Election Set for August 18
headline: What Hernando County Voters Need to Know Before the August 18 Primary
key_points: 2026 Primary Election is August 18, 2026; vote-by-mail request deadline August 6; early voting runs Saturday August 8 through Saturday August 15, 9am-6pm; contested nonpartisan School Board races in Districts 1, 3, and 5.
angle: Civic-service explainer covering key dates and local school board races ahead of the primary.
sources: Hernando County Supervisor of Elections (hernandovotes.gov), Hernando County government (hernandocounty.us), The Ballot Brief

title: Crystal River Man Faces Felony Animal Cruelty Charges After Puppies Found Dead
headline: Crystal River Man Arrested on Five Felony Counts After Decomposing Dogs Found in Home
key_points: Deputies conducting a wellbeing check on West Sandra Street in Crystal River found the remains of multiple dogs and five puppies in active decay inside the home; six surviving adult dogs removed and taken to Citrus County Animal Services for veterinary exams; suspect Ryan Michael White, 52, charged with five felony counts of animal cruelty; additional charges possible pending exam results.
angle: Straight local-crime report; note ongoing investigation and pending charges rather than a final disposition.
sources: Citrus County Chronicle (chronicleonline.com), FOX 13 Tampa Bay, WFLA
